title: Search-Space Accounting
negative_results: a candidate or match reported without a positive search-space count is refused (refuse_match_without_search_space), whether a dict or an object
a zero, negative, or non-integer dimension, and an empty search space, are refused
an out-of-range per-comparison probability or alpha is refused

claims.statement: The total number of hypotheses considered is the exact product over named dimensions (codecs x frames x depths x catalogue x transforms x orientations x shells x epochs x anchors x destinations), and it is reported with every candidate (POWER: product verified; a rare hit in a small space is surprising, a hit in a huge space is expected by chance).

A match is interpreted against the size of the space searched via the Sidak family-wise adjusted probability and the expected number of chance hits; a match without its search-space denominator is refused.

privacy_check: CLEAN - illustrative integer counts only, no inputs, no private data, no real coordinates
